hero.headline: Color-soaked stories painted by hand
hero.description: I craft vibrant, tactile paintings that invite you to pause, breathe, and feel. Each piece is made slowly and intentionally for intimate spaces that celebrate light.

featured.title: Featured originals
featured.description: A rotating selection of paintings currently in the studio. Each work is one of a kind and ships with a signed certificate of authenticity.

home.storyBody: From large-scale statement pieces to intimate works on paper, my paintings are built on layers of color, translucent glazes, and marks collected from travel. I believe art should feel personal, tactile, and alive.
home.collectorInvite: Collectors receive first access to new releases, studio visits, and commissions. Let's find the perfect piece for your space.

originals.title: Original paintings
originals.intro: Every painting is created in small batches in my light-filled studio. Works ship worldwide, crated with museum-grade materials and insured delivery.

about.title: Hi, I'm Adriana - painter, traveler, collector of color.
about.paragraph1: My practice lives at the intersection of intuition and structure. Raised between Colombia, Spain and Dominican Republic, I draw inspiration from architecture, vintage textiles, and the rhythm of everyday rituals.
about.paragraph2: Each painting begins as a field of gestures - inks, charcoal, stitched marks - and evolves through translucent layers of oil and acrylic. I build surfaces that invite touch and reward close looking.
about.paragraph3: I have exhibited in Latin America and Europe, and my originals live in private collections across both continents. My studio is open by appointment for collectors and collaborators.
about.practiceDescription: Large-scale canvases, works on paper, and bespoke commissions crafted in limited series.
about.inspirationDescription: Sun-faded facades, botanical forms, found typography, and music-filled evenings.

contact.title: Let's create something together
contact.intro: For sales inquiries, collaborations, or studio visits, reach out using the form or via email. I respond to every message within two business days.
